changes: Implemented B-2522 milestones 7-8: added receipt-backed authority classification helpers and smokes, added authority enforce matrix and live Python self-skip smokes, wired package scripts, refreshed authority docs, recorded verification evidence, reviewer passes, delivery check, and transcript evidence.
usage: Run npm run test:authority-receipt-classification for signed receipt classification, npm run test:authority-enforce-matrix for local/shadow/enforce matrix, npm run test:authority-live-python for optional live Python policy discovery, and lattice authority status for local authority readiness.

actualTranscript: Actual transcript matched: authority receipt classification smoke passed; authority enforce matrix smoke passed with all five PASS cells; live Python smoke skipped due missing KOALA_AUTHORITY_LIVE_URL and KOALA_AUTHORITY_LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY; authority/status/runner/event/evidence/parallel smokes passed; lattice validate reported 6/6 covered and allPass true.

limitations: Live Python smoke only performs real policy discovery when KOALA_AUTHORITY_LIVE_URL and KOALA_AUTHORITY_LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY are configured; local run intentionally self-skips that external dependency. Otherwise none - fully covered by deterministic smokes.

First validate failed because CHK-002 tests had passed but verificationEvidence was not yet recorded; fixed by recording all three CHK-002 intent evidence entries and refreshing stale CHK-001 hashes after the code commit.
